attributes.name: Blast Vortex
attributes.powers:
For your combat check, discard this card to use your Arcane or Divine skill. You may additinoally discard any number of spells that have the Attack trait; for each additional spell discarded, add 1d20 and that spell's straits to the check. 

After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it. Otherwise, you may expend any number of mythic charges; for each charge expended, recharge one of those spells instead of discarding it.
